stage1.impression: A plausible shallow-focus bar detail: the coupe, the request column and the blurred speaker and fir shelving behind give it some life, and the bokeh is lens-like. But it is too bright and grey for a night room. The concrete counter is a pale, evenly lit, marble-mottled slab that gets brighter toward the camera, the smoked record player reads as flat grey plastic slabs with no glowing edges, and the loudest colour in the frame is the stack of multicoloured coins rather than an EARF product. As it stands it reads as a well-made CG product still, not a specific place a magazine would publish; the room behind is too out of focus and generic to identify.

blocking_9: Frame lum_median within 22-50 (now 67.8) with the counter top as a pool of light that falls off away from the drink, not a flat bright plane (counter region [600,450,1200,800] median now 134)
Concrete counter reads as board-formed/cast concrete warmed by 2400-2700 K light: no marble-like grey-green mottling, lower albedo, a soft sheen
R3 Float's smoked slab reads as thick cast acrylic: polished edges that catch light and clean reflections, not matte grey sheet
An EARF product (the record player's tint, or the blurred speaker) is the frame's colour hero; the coins' multicolour stripes do not outshout it
The props on the card (mixing glass, open bottle, votive, matchbook) are visible and give the 'drink just poured' story; something identifies the room as Planet EARF
No visible grain or blotchy denoiser texture in the out-of-focus background

defects.what: Overall too bright for a night interior: lum_median 67.8, only 26.7 % below 40
Counter top median 134, flat and brightening toward the camera (profile 58 -> 144); no pool of light, reads as daylit marble
Concrete has grey-green, blotchy marble/terrazzo-like mottling and patchy pattern that repeats; ΔE2000 8.9 from a warm concrete #7A756D, too light
Record player's smoked slabs read as flat grey plastic boxes; edges dull, no edge glow, bottom slab a uniform grey band
Thin bright vertical line (a clear post or rod) crossing the shelving and the deck; reads as a stray artifact
Request column's coins are the most saturated object (r_median 132 vs g 95); stripes of red, blue, teal read as poker chips and steal the colour from EARF's products
Column base's light reads as a cold bluish-white strip, cooler than every other source
Coupe bowl and stem are mirror-like chrome rather than glass; the coupe partly hides the request column
Blurred background speaker and wall show visible grain/blotch noise in the bokeh
Pale disc on the counter (a coaster or coin?) reads as a floating flat ellipse
Record sleeve and black block at right edge cut by the frame and read as clutter, not a sign of life
Mixing glass, open bottle, votive and matchbook listed in the props are not legible in the frame

changes.problem: The frame is about a stop too bright for a night interior.
changes.expected: Frame median falls to about 40, shadows on the shelving and deck deepen while the column glow and coupe highlights stay legible.

changes.problem: The concrete counter is too light and mottled grey-green, reading as marble or terrazzo rather than warm cast concrete.

evidence.measured: RGB median 149/138/126, ΔE2000 8.9 vs #7A756D; blotchy marbled texture at 1:1

change.from: light grey, high-contrast mottled texture, matte
change.to: mid-dark warm grey around #6E6A63 albedo, mottling contrast halved and scaled up to pour-line/formwork scale, a low satin sheen (roughness ~0.55) so the pool of light reads as a soft sheen

changes.expected: Counter reads as concrete at the right scale and sits darker than the drink and the column.

changes.problem: The counter is lit flat and gets brighter toward the camera, so there is no pool of light around the drink.

evidence.measured: falloff along y 58 -> 101 -> 109 -> 140 -> 139 -> 133 -> 140 -> 144: flat, rising to the lens

change.to: the Dome over the decks aimed at the coupe/column at 140 W, cone 14 deg; the others 90 W, so the light falls off by at least half within 25 cm of the coupe base

changes.expected: A pool on the counter around the coupe and column, with the foreground counter edge falling into shadow.

changes.problem: The record player's smoked slabs read as matte grey plastic; their edges never catch light.

evidence.measured: lum_median 58.8, p95 156; slab edges dull grey bands with no bright edge line

change.setting: the record wall spots / a small added kicker on the deck
change.from: record wall 30 W, 2600 K, cone 26 deg, falling behind the deck
change.to: one record-wall spot re-aimed to graze the R3 Float's front edge from above and behind at 40 W, cone 18 deg, so the polished edges glow; raise the lit base under the deck so its clear posts show

changes.expected: A thin bright line along each smoked slab's polished edge and a clean reflection of the shelving in its top, reading as thick cast acrylic.

changes.problem: The coupe hides the request column and the props that tell 'a drink just poured' (mixing glass, open bottle, votive, matchbook) are not in the frame.

evidence.measured: coupe bowl overlaps the column's lower half; no bottle, mixing glass, votive or matchbook visible anywhere

change.from: coupe in front of the column, other props out of frame
change.to: coupe moved 12 cm left onto the napkin clear of the column; mixing glass and open bottle placed behind and right of the column in the focus plane; one lit votive at the right third near the sleeve, the matchbook beside it

changes.expected: The column reads whole, the drink story is legible, the votive adds a warm small source on the right.

changes.problem: The column's base light is cold bluish-white, the only cool source in a warm room.

evidence.measured: bright strip p95 187.5 that reads blue-white against the 2400-2700 K room

change.setting: the request column's base light colour (a glowing surface, under 'light colours of every source')
change.to: 2700 K, and at 70 % of its current strength so the coins are lit from below rather than the base being the brightest thing

changes.expected: Base glow warm and in key with the room; coins glow from inside the tube.

changes.problem: The coupe reads as polished chrome, not glass.

evidence.measured: bowl and stem fully mirror-reflective with dark opaque body, crush 5.9 %

change.to: clear glass IOR 1.5, zero metallic, with the drink an amber-red liquid filling two-thirds of the bowl so light passes through it

changes.expected: Glass shows transmission and a warm glow of the drink against the counter.

changes.problem: The out-of-focus background shows grain and blotchy denoiser texture.

evidence.measured: visible speckle on the blurred speaker and walls at 1:1

changes.expected: Smooth bokeh with only fine, film-like grain.

out_of_scope.request: Make the EARF record player, not the coins, the frame's colour hero by giving it a stronger tint
out_of_scope.why: EARF's products' colour is fixed by the card (Smoke configuration); only light and camera can bring it forward.

out_of_scope.request: Replace the multicoloured EARFcoins with coins in the configuration's tint
out_of_scope.why: The coins are part of the project's concept as given; their colours may be a design decision. Worth asking the owner, since they break the 'colour from the products alone' rule.

out_of_scope.request: Bring a recognisable feature of the room (altar, screens, counter's sculpted edge) into the frame so it reads as a specific place
out_of_scope.why: Would need a camera move changing the shot's purpose (a close detail); flag to the art director rather than prescribe.
